bun test writes transpiled copies of large test files (about 50 KB and up), with test titles in plain text, to ~/Library/Caches/bun/@t@, and no sandbox profile denied that directory: a leak path for hidden tests. The round-5 runner scores with that cache off. Clear the cache before any freeze, then run `bun run.ts canary`.
